narrative: A black-letter bill on the peg, read in the tiring-house before he goes on as Gaunt. The title is the whole of the print. No man is named under it. The river is not a direction he takes. He leaves the sheet where the unread afternoons of other houses live. His own roll is the cut king. He turns to that.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the title, and did not start for the river.

entities.name: New World's Tragedy
entities.context: Shown on bill in New World's Tragedy
